weapon.d:
Enables【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】.
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X (for unit, X = 15; for allies, X = 5), neutralizes penalties, and deals +Y damage during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; for unit, Y = 25; for allies, Y = 10), and restores 7 HP after combat.
Reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack, and grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit before unit's first attack during combat.
【Canto (Dist. +1; Max ４)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move spaces = number of spaces from start position to end position of unit before the above, +1. (Max ４.)

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

Boosts damage by 70% of unit's Def when Special triggers.
If unit's or foe's Special is ready, or unit's or foe's Special triggered before or during this combat, and also, if unit's Def ≥ foe's Def-10, reduces damage from foe's next attack by 40% (once per combat; excluding area-of-effect Specials).

a.d: If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def during combat = X + 1. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 1.)

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def during combat = X + 3. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 2.)

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def during combat = X + 5. (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 3.)

If unit or foe initiates combat after moving to a different space, grants Atk/Def+6 and Atk/Def+X to unit during combat (X = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat; max 4), and also, if unit initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's attacks by X × 3 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials). If foe's attack triggers foe's Special, reduces damage dealt to unit by X × 3 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).

c.d: At start of turn, grants Def+2 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Def+3 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Def+4 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.

At start of turn, if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+6 and “neutralizes foe’s bonuses during combat” to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def = number of allies on the map with the "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat" status effect active + 2 (excluding unit; max 5) and deals damage = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat × 2 during combat (max 8; excluding area-of-effect Specials).
